title: Rest of Ireland
description: Panoramic Ireland create photography tours and workshops throughout Ireland for everyone
html:
From the mediaeval streets of Kilkenny to the wild landscapes of Galway, Clare, Cork and Kerry Ireland is home to the stereotypical Irish landscapes that people love. With some careful planning each of these counties can be a destination in themselves or combined into a tour around the country.

From archaeological remains to modern streetscapes, the photography enthusiast has plenty to focus on in this small island. A plan of action is necessary, on a two-week trip it is possible to see a lot of Ireland; depending on what you want to get from a photography workshop or photo tour it is possible to cover the whole island or concentrate on a region such as Connemara or Kerry. 

We are now taking bookings for our residential photography workshops in Galway. Your accommodation is in a secluded lakeside house close to Galway city and within easy reach of Connemara, The Burren and Co. Mayo's stunning landscapes.

We offer weekend photography courses, four-day courses and seven-day courses all in a maximum group size of three. Our popular four-day course is a workshop / tour combination dealing with specific techniques such as making panoramic images, long exposure photography and digital workflow. We will visit all of the best that this part of the west of Ireland has to offer. This blog post covers a typical four-day Galway photography itinerary in more detail, but if you have any questions please do not hesitate to ask.
